stories.title: Rebuilt the weekly report
stories.situation: The weekly sales report took two analysts a full day to assemble by hand.
stories.task: I was asked to cut the effort without losing any of the figures finance relied on.
stories.action: I scripted the extraction, wrote a reconciliation check and ran both reports side by side for a month.
stories.result: Assembly time fell from 8 hours to 1 hour and finance signed off on the new version.
stories.source: Analyst role at the retail job, 2024
